hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Design a grid where only one sequence of down and right steps connects source to destination.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Keep the top boundary row and right boundary column clear of obstructions.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Place obstacle blocks everywhere off this single designated path.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def constructUniquePathGrid(m: int, n: int) -> list[list[int]]:
    grid = [[1] * n for _ in range(m)]
    # First row is free: (0, 0) -> (0, n-1)
    for c in range(n):
        grid[0][c] = 0
    # Last column is free: (0, n-1) -> (m-1, n-1)
    for r in range(m):
        grid[r][n - 1] = 0
    return grid
```
